name: Chaptarr
description: An audiobook and eBook collection manager. A Readarr fork built to accommodate audiobook and eBook libraries in one instance.

notes.text: Chaptarr is beta software. It is under active development. Bugs are likely; breaking changes less so.
Open http://<IP>:8789 and complete the setup wizard to create the admin account on first launch. The configuration is stored in /opt/chaptarr_data, outside the app directory, so it survives updates.
